The role covers three areas: GTM performance and channel economics, GTM data strategy and governance, and analytical support for forecasting, planning, and executive reporting. Your work is the analytical engine behind all three.

You set the analytical agenda for your areas. You decide which questions matter most, focus effort on the highest-value work, and turn findings into recommendations that change where Thatch invests. You will partner closely with Marketing, Data Science, Finance, and RevOps.

What you'll do

Strategic Decision Support

• Break down ambiguous GTM questions, combining data, financial implications, and operational context.

• Lead high-stakes segment, channel, and territory analyses from problem definition through recommendation.

• Present findings, risks, and tradeoffs clearly to senior leadership.

Background we're looking for

• Experience. 5 to 8 years in GTM analytics, RevOps, BizOps, strategy, or FP&A at a high-growth B2B company, with direct partnership with sales, marketing, and finance leadership.

• Technical depth. Expert SQL. Deep experience with sales and product telemetry data, mainstream business intelligence tools.

description: Description QuantumDiamonds is a novel equipment vendor from Germany which builds magnetic field imaging systems based on quantum sensors. Our Data Science & Machine Learning team in Pre-Development owns the chain from raw quantum sensor data to the current map an engineer can act on: the statistical evaluation of the sensor signal, the simulation and training data pipelines, the reconstruction of fields and currents, with the machine learning pipeline for three-dimensional current in production today, and the validation of every map against simulation and reference measurements. We are looking for a Data Scientist to own one question for the team: can we trust this map, and if not, where in the chain did it go wrong? Every measurement, in our lab or at a customer, gets a verdict and a reason. You build the checks that produce it, keep the catalogue of known artifacts and reference measurements behind it, and make it automatic for the routine cases so that your judgement goes to the hard ones. When a check fails, you trace it to its source in the chain, fix it when it sits in the evaluation, and drive the fix with the owning engineer when it does not. Our Applications engineers, who run the customer projects, rely on your verdict for what reaches the customer. A senior data scientist on the team backs you on the hard calls at the start; the aim is that you become the owner of this question. This is a hands-on analysis role, not a research position: the data is real, the chain is in daily use, and every improvement you make shows up in the next measurement. Your background does not need to be in quantum sensing or semiconductors: if you have learned to tell signal from noise, calibration errors and artifacts in another demanding measurement system, we want to hear from you.

title: Sales Operations- CRM Lead (Europe)- 6-month interim
description:
Who We Are
On July 1, 2025, IPL Plastics merged with Schoeller Allibert to form IPL Schoeller (the ‘company’). The Company’s operations are split across North America (11 manufacturing plants) and Europe (16 manufacturing plants).
The company is headquartered in Dublin, Ireland. IPL Schoeller is a leading manufacturer of sustainable rigid packaging solutions across a range of end market segments including returnable transit packaging, consumer and industrial packaging, environmental containers and agricultural packaging. The company employs c.4,100 employees across North America (1,600 employees) and Europe (2,500 employees.)

The role
We are seeking a CRM Lead to own and evolve our CRM capability across the European Commercial organization. Reporting into Sales Operations, this role serves as the key link between Commercial teams, IT, Business Data, and technology partners to ensure CRM systems, processes, and data support business growth, customer engagement, pipeline visibility, and operational efficiency.
We are looking to fill this this as a 6-month temporary position.
This is a strategic, hands-on role focused on CRM product ownership, process optimization, user adoption, data governance, reporting, and continuous improvement rather than day-to-day system administration.
Key Responsibilities

• Own the European CRM strategy, governance model, and roadmap aligned with business objectives.

• Act as the Commercial business owner for CRM and related sales technologies.

• Partner with IT, data teams, and external vendors to deliver CRM enhancements, integrations, and new capabilities.

• Drive CRM adoption through training, change management, and user enablement initiatives.

• Design and improve sales processes, including lead, opportunity, pipeline, and customer lifecycle management.

• Establish and maintain CRM data quality, governance, and compliance standards.

• Develop dashboards, reports, and insights that support commercial decision-making.

• Manage stakeholder relationships and prioritize enhancement requests based on business value.

Qualifications
Required

• Significant experience in CRM management, product ownership, implementation, or commercial systems leadership.

• Hands-on CRM configuration, workflow, reporting, and data management experience in a B2B environment.

• Strong understanding of sales operations, pipeline management, and commercial processes.

• Experience working with IT, developers, data teams, and third-party providers.

• Proven success driving user adoption, training, and process change.

• Strong analytical, project management, and stakeholder engagement skills.

• Fluent in English.

Preferred

• Experience with HubSpot or other enterprise CRM platforms.

• Knowledge of reporting and automation tools such as Power BI, Looker Studio, BigQuery , or similar.

• Experience supporting multi-country European commercial organizations.

• Understanding of CRM data governance, privacy, and security requirements.

• Background in manufacturing, industrial, or complex B2B environments.

• Additional European language skills.

Success in This Role
You will be measured by:

• Increased CRM adoption and user engagement.

• Improved data quality and consistency.

• Successful delivery of CRM enhancements and integrations.

• Better pipeline visibility, reporting, and commercial insights.

• Increased automation and operational efficiency.

• Standardized commercial processes across regions.

This opportunity is ideal for a CRM leader who combines technical expertise, commercial understanding, and change management skills to transform CRM into a strategic business capability.
If you have the above experience and are looking for a role where you can make a real difference, apply today to find out more!
